phase_time_definition: P collect and D first visible token are timed from entry into the HTTP handler. transport_other includes network/framework/serialization outside those intervals. CUDA stream times include kernels, collectives and launch gaps, and overlap host times.
comparison_limitations: Warm repeated-prompt workload with Store hit; not a cold long-prefill or saturated throughput benchmark.
P4+D4 and two Hybrid4 groups both use eight H200 GPUs. This comparison does not establish an optimal P:D ratio for other traffic.
Concurrent baseline outputs are not exactly reproducible. Serial checks do not resolve all earlier boundary-token differences.
All configurations retain decode save-first/interval=1024. Save-on/off saturation performance was not tested.
PD benchmark binary predates only the final empty-messages eligibility guard; measured requests all have nonempty text messages. Final guard passed router tests and its release binary was installed.
No vLLM/SGLang GPU benchmark was run; those systems supplied code/deployment references only.
